messages:
Ivy (Design): dropping a lightweight prototype for a 'Compact review' mode for Prompt Sets + Evals. idea: super-dense list + an optional 'focus mode' that centers one run (keyboard-first) so reviewers can quickly triage and approve without opening full panels. mock: https://figma.redwood/compact-focus

Marco (Product): curious: how would focus-mode differ from our current expand/inspect flow? main goal: speed for power reviewers (approve next) vs discoverability for casual users.

Ivy (Design): focus-mode is single-pane: press `F` to enter, current run is centered with full scorecard and diff inline. `J/K` navigate runs, `Enter` approves (shows ephemeral banner with Undo). it's optimized for keyboard-only reviewers and removes side rail distractions. exit with `Esc` to return to list.

Tess (Eng): implementation notes: can reuse existing scorecard and diff components. challenge: virtualized list + focus-mode needs smooth scroll into view and state sync; also must be careful to avoid rehydration jank. approve action should be idempotent and return minimal payload for undo.

Rui (A11y): a11y concerns: focus-mode must manage focus correctly (trap while active), provide a visible and programmatic way to exit, announce mode entry via `aria-live` with brief description, and ensure `Enter` approve has an accessible confirmation state. avoid modal traps; use roving tabindex pattern. also add keyboard-only affordance for mobile or touch fallback.

Omar (Research): quick study idea: compare time-to-first-approve with `focus-mode` vs current flow. in a small internal test, reviewers completed triaging 20 runs ~24% faster with a keyboard-first flow. we should instrument time metrics. also test cognitive load with eye-tracking if possible.

Paula (DevEx): copy & microcopy nits: banners + ephemeral toasts should be short. propose: on approve: `Run approved — Undo (7s)`; on undo tapped: `Approval reverted`. For entry to focus-mode tooltip: `Focus mode: J/K to navigate, Enter to approve, Esc to exit`. include accessible longform in help.

Ivy (Design): visual notes: compact rows reduce padding, hide redundant labels, show a tiny mini-score left (2 metrics) and regression badge on right. in focus-mode show the full scorecard with a highlighted "regressions" strip. added subtle motion when switching runs to avoid jumpiness.

Tess (Eng): perf: compact rows + reduced DOM should be fine. we'll add a feature-flag `compact_review` and a user preference saved client-side. server-side only needs to serve same data. undo: soft-undo via tombstone state for 7s; full revert call if undone.

Rui (A11y): extra a11y asks: 1) Ensure regression badge includes text `Regressions: 2` (not color only). 2) Announce when switching runs: `Now viewing run 3 of 120`. 3) Provide skip-to-list link for screen reader users to escape focus-mode quickly.

Marco (Product): product tradeoffs: power users get speed; novices could miss features. proposal: ship as an opt-in toggle with a short onboarding tooltip that triggers once. also add analytics: `focus_mode_enter`, `approve_via_focus`, `approve_undo`.

Omar (Research): add a small bias-safety check: when focus-mode is on, show blind-review lab toggle (hide user/prompt metadata) so raters don't get primed. measure changes in label distributions.

Paula (DevEx): docs: add keyboard cheat-sheet to Prompt Sets docs, include accessible examples for screen reader users. also add video gif in the onboarding.

Tess (Eng): timeline: I can prototype compact rows + focus-mode entry/exit next sprint. will include smooth scroll and aria-live announcements. ETA: 12 working days for spike + prototype branch.

Ivy (Design): I'll hand off updated mocks (desktop + keyboard-first touch fallbacks) and microcopy. also include focus indicators and reduced-motion-friendly transitions.

Rui (A11y): I'll create an a11y acceptance checklist for focus-mode: trapping behavior, escape path, live-region announcements, regression text, and undo announcement. happy to review prototype.

Marco (Product): decision: proceed as opt-in lab feature behind `compact_review`. Tess & Ivy to collaborate on prototype. Omar & Rui to validate research & a11y. Paula to update docs and shortcuts. thanks! :rocket:
